identity.statusNote: The seed URL practiceignition.com now 301-redirects permanently to ignitionapp.com, reflecting the vendor's rebrand from Practice Ignition to Ignition.

cautions.en: The pricing page renders plan names and dollar amounts dynamically (monthly/annual toggle); the fetched content only confirmed the 14-day trial and add-on names, not the underlying tier prices, which must be reverified on a rendered page before use.

capabilities.en: Creates professional online proposals with upselling options for service-based businesses.
Manages contracts and engagement letters digitally alongside proposals.
Captures client payment details upfront and automates billing and invoicing.
AI-powered price insights to help set service pricing, plus workflow automation templates and custom intake forms.

limitations.en: Exact pricing tiers and dollar amounts are not published as static content; they require a JavaScript-rendered page or contacting sales to see plan costs.
Positioned for accounting, bookkeeping, consulting and professional services firms rather than a general-purpose proposal tool, per the target industries listed.
